        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context

        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,

            list(self.tools) if hasattr(self, "tools") and not override else []
        )

    async def tts_node(
        self, text: AsyncIterable[str], model_settings: ModelSettings
    ) -> AsyncIterable[rtc.AudioFrame]:
        # Check if any text content exists, if all strings are empty return early
        has_content = False
        text_buffer = []
        async for text_chunk in text:
            text_buffer.append(text_chunk)
            if text_chunk.strip():  # Check if string is not empty or just whitespace
                has_content = True

        if not has_content:
            return

        # Convert buffer back to async iterable
        async def buffered_text() -> AsyncIterable[str]:
            for chunk in text_buffer:
                yield chunk

        async for frame in Agent.default.tts_node(
            self, buffered_text(), model_settings
        ):
            # Insert custom audio processing here
            yield frame

def _get_next_task(self) -> TaskConfiguration | None:
        # If there are items in in_progress_task_ids, take the last item from the list
        if self.in_progress_task_ids:
            task_id = self.in_progress_task_ids[-1]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # Otherwise get the first item from outstanding_task_ids
        if self.outstanding_task_ids:
            task_id = self.outstanding_task_ids[0]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # If both lists are empty
        return None

    def _complete_task(self, task: BaseTaskConfiguration) -> None:
        """
        Completes a task by removing it from in_progress_task_ids, outstanding_task_ids, and adding it to completed_task_ids.
        """
        if task.id in self.in_progress_task_ids:
            self.in_progress_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        if task.id in self.outstanding_task_ids:
            self.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        self.completed_task_ids.append(task.id)

    def _load_task_agent(self, task: TaskConfiguration) -> BaseTaskAgent:
        logger.debug(
            f"Loading Task Agent for task: {task.id} with agent {task.task_agent_type}"
        )
        chat_ctx = self.conversation_context.generate_context(
            remove_last_user_responses=False
        )

        orchestration_ctx = OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=self.task_agent_hooks,
            chat_ctx=chat_ctx,
            job_details=self.job_details,
            candidate_data_point_schemas=self.candidate_datapoint_schemas,
            outstanding_task_ids=self.outstanding_task_ids,
            completed_task_ids=self.completed_task_ids,
            in_progress_task_ids=self.in_progress_task_ids,
        )

        match task.task_agent_type:
            case TaskAgentType.GREETING:
                return GreeterTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultGreeterTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )

"""
Voice Agent Call Script Orchestrator

Load in a call script and manage the state of the conversation against the call script.
"""

import logging
from collections.abc import Awaitable
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import AutoSubscribe
from livekit.agents import JobContext
from livekit.agents import RoomInputOptions

from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentType
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task import TaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorFailedTask
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentHooks
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest
from voice_agent.task_agent.base_agent import BaseTaskAgent
from voice_agent.task_agent.closer_agent import CloserTaskAgent
from voice_agent.task_agent.closer_agent import DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import DataCollectionTaskAgent
from voice_agent.task_agent.data_collection_agent import (
    DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig,
)
from voice_agent.task_agent.greeter_agent import DefaultGreeterTaskAgentConfig
from voice_agent.task_agent.greeter_agent import GreeterTaskAgent
from voice_agent.task_agent.information_agent import (
    DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig,
)
from voice_agent.task_agent.information_agent import InformationTaskAgent

from .conversation_context import VoiceAgentConversationContext


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class CallScriptOrchestrator:
    def __init__(
        self,
        call_script: CallScript,
        session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        on_finish_cleanup: Callable[[str], Awaitable[Any]],
    ):
        self.session = session
        self.on_finish_cleanup = on_finish_cleanup

        self.job_details = call_script.context.job
        self.candidate_datapoint_schemas = call_script.candidate_data_point_schemas

        self.conversation_context = VoiceAgentConversationContext()

        self.task_map: dict[str, TaskConfiguration] = {
            task.id: task for task in call_script.tasks
        }
        self.outstanding_task_ids: list[str] = [task.id for task in call_script.tasks]
        self.in_progress_task_ids: list[str] = []
        self.completed_task_ids: list[str] = []
        self.failed_tasks: list[OrchestratorFailedTask] = []

        self.task_agent_hooks: TaskAgentHooks = TaskAgentHooks(
            on_task_agent_interrupt=self.on_task_agent_interrupt,
            on_task_agent_finished=self.on_task_agent_finished,
            on_datapoint_collected=self.on_candidate_datapoint_collected,
            on_end_call=self.on_end_call,
        )

        logger.debug(
            f"Initialized CallScriptOrchestrator with call_script: {call_script.id} - {call_script.call_script_version}"
        )

    async def start(
        self, ctx: JobContext, room_input_options: RoomInputOptions
    ) -> None:
        await ctx.connect(auto_subscribe=AutoSubscribe.AUDIO_ONLY)
        task = self._get_next_task()
        if not task:
            await self.done("No Tasks to start. Ending Session")
            return
        agent = self._load_task_agent(task)
        logger.debug("Agent loaded")
        await self.session.start(
            room=ctx.room, agent=agent, room_input_options=room_input_options
        )
        logger.debug(f"Voice Agent Session started with task: {task.id} - {task.title}")

    async def on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self, interrupt_request: TaskAgentInterruptRequest
    ) -> None:
        if interrupt_request.type == TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_INITIATE_END_CALL:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions="Acknowledge candidate reason for ending call and thank them for their time."
            )
            await self.on_end_call(interrupt_request.interrupt_note)
            self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption = None
            return
        ## TODO: PLACEHOLDER FOR NOW
        await self.session.generate_reply(
            instructions=f"Apology to the candidate for `{interrupt_request.interrupt_note}` and redirect candidate focus back to the task at hand."
        )
        self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption = None
        return

    async def on_task_agent_finished(
        self, current_agent_task: BaseTaskConfiguration, explanation: str
    ) -> None:
        logger.debug(
            f"current state: {self.session.userdata.model_dump_json(indent=2)}"
        )
        self.conversation_context.update_from_chat_context(self.session._chat_ctx)
        self._complete_task(current_agent_task)
        next_task = self._get_next_task()
        if not next_task:
            await self.done(explanation)
            return
        self.session.update_agent(self._load_task_agent(next_task))
        return

    async def on_candidate_datapoint_collected(
        self, key: str, value: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> None:
        logger.debug(f"Collected datapoint: {key} - {value}")
        return

    async def on_end_call(self, reason: str) -> None:
        # Move all in-progress tasks to completed tasks
        for task_id in self.in_progress_task_ids:
            if task_id not in self.completed_task_ids:
                self.completed_task_ids.append(task_id)
        self.in_progress_task_ids.clear()
        logger.debug(f"Final State: {self.session.userdata.model_dump_json(indent=2)}")
        logger.debug(f"Completed Tasks: {self.completed_task_ids}")
        logger.debug(f"Outstanding Tasks: {self.outstanding_task_ids}")
        logger.debug(f"Failed Tasks: {self.failed_tasks}")
        logger.debug(f"Conversation: {self.conversation_context}")
        await self.done(reason)

    async def done(self, reason: str = "") -> None:
        await self.on_finish_cleanup(reason)
        logger.debug(f"Voice Agent Session ended with reason: {reason}")

    def _get_next_task(self) -> TaskConfiguration | None:
        # If there are items in in_progress_task_ids, take the last item from the list
        if self.in_progress_task_ids:
            task_id = self.in_progress_task_ids[-1]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # Otherwise get the first item from outstanding_task_ids
        if self.outstanding_task_ids:
            task_id = self.outstanding_task_ids[0]
            return self.task_map[task_id]

        # If both lists are empty
        return None

    def _complete_task(self, task: BaseTaskConfiguration) -> None:
        """
        Completes a task by removing it from in_progress_task_ids, outstanding_task_ids, and adding it to completed_task_ids.
        """
        if task.id in self.in_progress_task_ids:
            self.in_progress_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        if task.id in self.outstanding_task_ids:
            self.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        self.completed_task_ids.append(task.id)

    def _load_task_agent(self, task: TaskConfiguration) -> BaseTaskAgent:
        logger.debug(
            f"Loading Task Agent for task: {task.id} with agent {task.task_agent_type}"
        )
        chat_ctx = self.conversation_context.generate_context(
            remove_last_user_responses=False
        )

        orchestration_ctx = OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=self.task_agent_hooks,
            chat_ctx=chat_ctx,
            job_details=self.job_details,
            candidate_data_point_schemas=self.candidate_datapoint_schemas,
            outstanding_task_ids=self.outstanding_task_ids,
            completed_task_ids=self.completed_task_ids,
            in_progress_task_ids=self.in_progress_task_ids,
        )

        match task.task_agent_type:
            case TaskAgentType.GREETING:
                return GreeterTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultGreeterTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.DATA_COLLECTION:
                return DataCollectionTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.INFORMATION:
                return InformationTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultInformationTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case TaskAgentType.CLOSER:
                return CloserTaskAgent(
                    agent_config=DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig,
                    task_config=task,
                    orc_ctx=orchestration_ctx,
                )
            case _:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown task agent type: {task.task_agent_type}")

"""
Call Conversation Context Manager
Manages chat history and generates modified ChatContext instances for LiveKit agents
"""

import logging

from livekit.agents.llm import ChatContext
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatItem
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatMessage


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VoiceAgentConversationContext:
    """
    Manages conversation history and generates modified ChatContext instances.
    Stores chat items immutably and applies modifications only when generating output.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize empty conversation context"""
        self._items: list[ChatItem] = []
        self._item_ids: set[str] = set()  # Track seen item IDs to avoid duplicates

    def update_from_chat_context(self, chat_ctx: ChatContext) -> None:
        """
        Update internal storage with new items from LiveKit's ChatContext.
        Only adds items that haven't been seen before.

        Args:
            chat_ctx: LiveKit ChatContext to sync from
        """
        if not chat_ctx or not chat_ctx.items:
            return

        added_count = 0
        for item in chat_ctx.items:
            # Check if item has an ID and hasn't been seen
            if isinstance(item, ChatMessage) and hasattr(item, "id"):
                if item.id and item.id not in self._item_ids:
                    self._items.append(item)
                    self._item_ids.add(item.id)
                    added_count += 1
            else:
                # For items without IDs, check if it's already in our list
                # This is a simple check - you might want more sophisticated duplicate detection
                if item not in self._items:
                    self._items.append(item)
                    added_count += 1

        if added_count > 0:
            logger.debug(
                f"Added {added_count} new items from ChatContext, total: {len(self._items)}"
            )

    def _remove_last_user_responses(self, items: list[ChatItem]) -> list[ChatItem]:
        """
        Remove messages from the end while the last message has role 'user'.

        Args:
            items: List of chat items to process

        Returns:
            Modified list with trailing user messages removed
        """
        original_length = len(items)
        while items:
            last_item = items[-1]
            if (
                isinstance(last_item, ChatMessage)
                and hasattr(last_item, "role")
                and last_item.role == "user"
            ):
                items.pop()
            else:
                break

        removed_count = original_length - len(items)
        if removed_count > 0:
            logger.debug(
                f"Removed {removed_count} messages from the end (last message role was 'user')"
            )

        return items

    def generate_context(
        self,
        remove_last_user_responses: bool = False,
    ) -> ChatContext:
        """
        Generate a ChatContext with optional modification.

        Args:
            remove_last_user_responses: If True, removes messages from the end until the most recent message no longer has role 'user'

        Returns:
            Modified ChatContext for use with LiveKit agents
        """
        # Start with a copy of items
        items = self._items.copy()

        if remove_last_user_responses:
            items = self._remove_last_user_responses(items)

        logger.debug(
            f"Generated context with {len(items)} items "
            f"(original: {len(self._items)}, remove_last_user={remove_last_user_responses})"
        )

        return ChatContext(items=items)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Clear all stored conversation history"""
        self._items.clear()
        self._item_ids.clear()
        logger.info("Conversation context cleared")

    def snapshot(self) -> tuple[list[ChatItem], set[str]]:
        """
        Create a snapshot of current state for potential rollback.

        Returns:
            Tuple of (items copy, item_ids copy)
        """
        return (self._items.copy(), self._item_ids.copy())

    def restore(self, snapshot: tuple[list[ChatItem], set[str]]) -> None:
        """
        Restore from a previously created snapshot.

        Args:
            snapshot: Tuple from snapshot() method
        """
        self._items, self._item_ids = snapshot
        logger.info(f"Restored conversation context to {len(self._items)} items")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"VoiceAgentConversationContext(items={len(self._items)}, unique_ids={len(self._item_ids)})"

DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig = CloserTaskAgentConfiguration(
    name="Closer Agent",

    agent_instructions="You will end the call and letting them know that the call is over. Always thank them for their time",

class CloserTaskAgent(BaseTaskAgent):
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: CloserTaskAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: CloserTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        closer_agent_config = DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig.merge_config(
            agent_config=agent_config
        )
        super().__init__(
            agent_config=closer_agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orc_ctx,
        )
        self.agent_config = closer_agent_config
        self.task_config = task_config

    async def on_enter(self) -> None:
        if not self.session:
            return
        if self.task_config.initial_message:
            # If the current node has an initiation text, use it to generate a reply
            await self.session.say(
                text=self.task_config.initial_message, add_to_chat_ctx=True
            )
        elif self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions=f"end the call gracefully due to {self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption.interrupt_note}"
            )
            self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption = None
        else:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions=self.task_config.task_instructions
                or "end the call gracefully"
            )
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_end_call("Closer Task Agent Completed")

import logging
from typing import Any

from livekit.agents import RunContext

from voice_agent.enums import TaskProgrammaticAction

logger = logging.getLogger("data_collection_agent")


def data_collection_task_instruction_transformer(
    task_instruction: str | None,
    task_config: BaseTaskConfiguration,
    orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
) -> str:
    data_collection_task_config = cast(DataCollectionTaskConfiguration, task_config)

    data_point_descriptions = "\n".join(
        f"- {data_point}: {orc_ctx.candidate_data_point_schemas[data_point].description}"
        for data_point in data_collection_task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect
    )

    return f"""
    {task_instruction}

    Here are the data points you need to collect:
        {data_point_descriptions}

    Here are all information about the role: {orc_ctx.job_details.model_dump_json()}

        - Validate responses and use the appropriate tool to record them
        - If a candidate provides unclear information, ask for clarification before collecting
        - If a candidate provides data that is drastically deviated from job expectations, ask for clarification before collecting
        - Once all data points are collected, complete your task

import logging
from typing import Any
from typing import cast

from livekit.agents import RunContext
from livekit.agents import ToolError

from voice_agent.enums import TaskProgrammaticAction
from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.utils.datapoint_validator import CandidateDatapointValidator
from voice_agent.utils.tools_factory import create_datapoint_tools
from voice_agent.utils.tools_factory import create_hangup_tool

from .base_agent import BaseTaskAgent


logger = logging.getLogger("data_collection_agent")


def data_collection_task_instruction_transformer(
    task_instruction: str | None,
    task_config: BaseTaskConfiguration,
    orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
) -> str:
    data_collection_task_config = cast(DataCollectionTaskConfiguration, task_config)

    data_point_descriptions = "\n".join(
        f"- {data_point}: {orc_ctx.candidate_data_point_schemas[data_point].description}"
        for data_point in data_collection_task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect
    )

    return f"""
    {task_instruction}

    Here are the data points you need to collect:
        {data_point_descriptions}

    Here are all information about the role: {orc_ctx.job_details.model_dump_json()}

    Your task:
        - Collect all required data points using the appropriate collection tools
        - Each data point has a specific collection function - use the correct one
        - Validate responses and use the appropriate tool to record them
        - If a candidate provides unclear information, ask for clarification before collecting
        - If a candidate provides data that is drastically deviated from job expectations, ask for clarification before collecting
        - Once all data points are collected, complete your task
        - If after {len(data_collection_task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect) * 3} exchanges and not all data points are collected, call agent_feedback task to ask orchestrator for help

    Notes:
        - If data is not recorded successfully, confirm with the candidate on the data you collected and re-submit it again
        - You may have access to hangup tool to immediately end the conversation with the candidate. Only use them when you have access to the tool and already confirmed candidate does not meet the validation

    IMPORTANT: Use the specific collection tools provided for each data point. Do not use the generic collect_signal tool for these specific data points.
    """


DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig = DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
    name="Information",
    description="Information agent that provides information.",
    agent_instructions="You are an agent looking to collect a set of data point information from talking with candidate.",
    task_instruction_transformer=data_collection_task_instruction_transformer,
)


class DataCollectionTaskAgent(BaseTaskAgent):
    task_config: DataCollectionTaskConfiguration  # Type annotation for mypy

    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: DataCollectionAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: DataCollectionTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        data_collection_agent_config = (
            DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig.merge_config(agent_config=agent_config)
        )

        super().__init__(
            agent_config=data_collection_agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orc_ctx,
        )
        self.agent_config = data_collection_agent_config
        self.task_config = task_config
        self.validation_check_round_count = 0

    async def on_enter(self) -> None:
        """Called when the agent enters - register dynamic tools and start"""
        # Register dynamic tools if there are data points
        if self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect:
            await self._register_datapoint_tools()

        # Then proceed with normal on_enter behavior
        await super().on_enter()

    async def on_data_collected(
        self, run_context: RunContext[SessionDataState], key: str, value: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> str | None:
        """Called when a data point is collected"""
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_datapoint_collected(key, value)
        run_context.userdata.candidate_datapoints[key] = value
        if not all(
            key in run_context.userdata.candidate_datapoints
            for key in self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect
        ):
            return f"Data point {key} collected successfully. Move on to next one"
        if self.validation_check_round_count <= 0:
            self.validation_check_round_count += 1
            await self._run_candidate_datapoint_validation(
                run_context.userdata.candidate_datapoints
            )

        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished(
            self.task_config, TaskProgrammaticAction.NEXT_TASK
        )
        return None

    async def _run_candidate_datapoint_validation(
        self, candidate_datapoints: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> None:
        validator = CandidateDatapointValidator(candidate_datapoints)
        instructions_on_failures = []
        should_register_hangup_tool = False
        for validation in self.task_config.validations:
            if validator.validate(validation.query):
                continue
            if validation.can_end_call:
                should_register_hangup_tool = True
            instructions_on_failures.append(validation.instructions_on_failure)
        if should_register_hangup_tool:
            await self._register_hangup_tool()
        if instructions_on_failures:
            raise ToolError("\n".join(instructions_on_failures))
        return

    async def _register_hangup_tool(self) -> None:
        """Register dynamic tools for hangup"""

        await self.register_tools(
            [create_hangup_tool(self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_end_call)]
        )
        logger.debug("Registered hangup tool")

    async def _register_datapoint_tools(self) -> None:
        """Register dynamic tools for data point collection"""
        # Create dynamic tools based on JSON schemas with async callback
        datapoint_tools = create_datapoint_tools(
            self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect,
            self.orc_ctx.candidate_data_point_schemas,
            self.on_data_collected,
        )

        await self.register_tools(datapoint_tools)
        logger.debug(
            f"Tools registered for data points: {self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect}"
        )

"""
Call Conversation Context Manager
Manages chat history and generates modified ChatContext instances for LiveKit agents
"""

import logging

from livekit.agents.llm import ChatContext
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatItem
from livekit.agents.llm import ChatMessage


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VoiceAgentConversationContext:
    """
    Manages conversation history and generates modified ChatContext instances.
    Stores chat items immutably and applies modifications only when generating output.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize empty conversation context"""
        self._items: list[ChatItem] = []
        self._item_ids: set[str] = set()  # Track seen item IDs to avoid duplicates

    def update_from_chat_context(self, chat_ctx: ChatContext) -> None:
        """
        Update internal storage with new items from LiveKit's ChatContext.
        Only adds items that haven't been seen before.

        Args:
            chat_ctx: LiveKit ChatContext to sync from
        """
        if not chat_ctx or not chat_ctx.items:
            return

        added_count = 0
        for item in chat_ctx.items:
            # Check if item has an ID and hasn't been seen
            if isinstance(item, ChatMessage) and hasattr(item, "id"):
                if item.id and item.id not in self._item_ids:
                    self._items.append(item)
                    self._item_ids.add(item.id)
                    added_count += 1
            else:
                # For items without IDs, check if it's already in our list
                # This is a simple check - you might want more sophisticated duplicate detection
                if item not in self._items:
                    self._items.append(item)
                    added_count += 1

        if added_count > 0:
            logger.debug(
                f"Added {added_count} new items from ChatContext, total: {len(self._items)}"
            )

    def _remove_last_user_responses(self, items: list[ChatItem]) -> list[ChatItem]:
        """
        Remove messages from the end while the last message has role 'user'.

        Args:
            items: List of chat items to process

        Returns:
            Modified list with trailing user messages removed
        """
        original_length = len(items)
        while items:
            last_item = items[-1]
            if (
                isinstance(last_item, ChatMessage)
                and hasattr(last_item, "role")
                and last_item.role == "user"
            ):
                items.pop()
            else:
                break

        removed_count = original_length - len(items)
        if removed_count > 0:
            logger.debug(
                f"Removed {removed_count} messages from the end (last message role was 'user')"
            )

        return items

    def generate_context(
        self,
        remove_last_user_responses: bool = False,
    ) -> ChatContext:
        """
        Generate a ChatContext with optional modification.

        Args:
            remove_last_user_responses: If True, removes messages from the end until the most recent message no longer has role 'user'

        Returns:
            Modified ChatContext for use with LiveKit agents
        """
        # Start with a copy of items
        items = self._items.copy()

        if remove_last_user_responses:
            items = self._remove_last_user_responses(items)

        logger.debug(
            f"Generated context with {len(items)} items "
            f"(original: {len(self._items)}, remove_last_user={remove_last_user_responses})"
        )

        return ChatContext(items=items)

    def add_agent_message(self, content: str) -> None:
        """Add an agent message to the conversation"""
        message = ChatMessage(role="assistant", content=[content])
        self._items.append(message)
        logger.debug(f"Added agent message: {content[:50]}...")

    def add_user_message(self, content: str) -> None:
        """Add a user message to the conversation"""
        message = ChatMessage(role="user", content=[content])
        self._items.append(message)
        logger.debug(f"Added user message: {content[:50]}...")

    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Clear all stored conversation history"""
        self._items.clear()
        self._item_ids.clear()
        logger.info("Conversation context cleared")

    def snapshot(self) -> tuple[list[ChatItem], set[str]]:
        """
        Create a snapshot of current state for potential rollback.

        Returns:
            Tuple of (items copy, item_ids copy)
        """
        return (self._items.copy(), self._item_ids.copy())

    def restore(self, snapshot: tuple[list[ChatItem], set[str]]) -> None:
        """
        Restore from a previously created snapshot.

        Args:
            snapshot: Tuple from snapshot() method
        """
        self._items, self._item_ids = snapshot
        logger.info(f"Restored conversation context to {len(self._items)} items")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"VoiceAgentConversationContext(items={len(self._items)}, unique_ids={len(self._item_ids)})"

import logging
from typing import Any
from typing import cast

from livekit.agents import RunContext
from livekit.agents import ToolError

from voice_agent.enums import TaskProgrammaticAction
from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task import DataCollectionTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import DataCollectionAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.utils.datapoint_validator import CandidateDatapointValidator
from voice_agent.utils.tools_factory import create_datapoint_tools
from voice_agent.utils.tools_factory import create_hangup_tool

from .base_agent import BaseTaskAgent


logger = logging.getLogger("data_collection_agent")


def data_collection_task_instruction_transformer(
    task_instruction: str | None,
    task_config: BaseTaskConfiguration,
    orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
) -> str:
    data_collection_task_config = cast(DataCollectionTaskConfiguration, task_config)

    data_point_descriptions = "\n".join(
        f"- {data_point}: {orc_ctx.candidate_data_point_schemas[data_point].description}"
        for data_point in data_collection_task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect
    )

    return f"""
    {task_instruction}

    Here are the data points you need to collect:
        {data_point_descriptions}

    Here are all information about the role: {orc_ctx.job_details.model_dump_json()}

    Your task:
        - Collect all required data points using the appropriate collection tools
        - Each data point has a specific collection function - use the correct one
        - Validate responses and use the appropriate tool to record them
        - If a candidate provides unclear information, ask for clarification before collecting
        - If a candidate provides data that is drastically deviated from job expectations, ask for clarification before collecting
        - Once all data points are collected, complete your task
        - If after {len(data_collection_task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect) * 3} exchanges and not all data points are collected, call agent_feedback task to ask orchestrator for help

    Notes:
        - If data is not recorded successfully, confirm with the candidate on the data you collected and re-submit it again
        - You may have access to hangup tool to immediately end the conversation with the candidate. Only use them when you have access to the tool and already confirmed candidate does not meet the validation

    IMPORTANT: Use the specific collection tools provided for each data point. Do not use the generic collect_signal tool for these specific data points.
    """


DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig = DataCollectionAgentConfiguration(
    name="Data Collection",
    description="Agent that collects specific data points from candidates.",
    agent_instructions="You are an agent looking to collect a set of data point information from talking with candidate.",
    task_instruction_transformer=data_collection_task_instruction_transformer,
)


class DataCollectionTaskAgent(BaseTaskAgent):
    task_config: DataCollectionTaskConfiguration  # Type annotation for mypy

    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: DataCollectionAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: DataCollectionTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        data_collection_agent_config = (
            DefaultDataCollectionTaskAgentConfig.merge_config(agent_config=agent_config)
        )

        super().__init__(
            agent_config=data_collection_agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orc_ctx,
        )
        self.agent_config = data_collection_agent_config
        self.task_config = task_config
        self.validation_check_round_count = 0

    async def on_enter(self) -> None:
        """Called when the agent enters - register dynamic tools and start"""
        # Register dynamic tools if there are data points
        if self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect:
            await self._register_datapoint_tools()

        # Then proceed with normal on_enter behavior
        await super().on_enter()

    async def on_data_collected(
        self, run_context: RunContext[SessionDataState], key: str, value: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> str | None:
        """Called when a data point is collected"""
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_datapoint_collected(key, value)
        run_context.userdata.candidate_datapoints[key] = value
        if not all(
            key in run_context.userdata.candidate_datapoints
            for key in self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect
        ):
            return f"Data point {key} collected successfully. Move on to next one"
        if self.validation_check_round_count <= 0:
            self.validation_check_round_count += 1
            await self._run_candidate_datapoint_validation(
                run_context.userdata.candidate_datapoints
            )

        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished(
            self.task_config, TaskProgrammaticAction.NEXT_TASK
        )
        return None

    async def _run_candidate_datapoint_validation(
        self, candidate_datapoints: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> None:
        validator = CandidateDatapointValidator(candidate_datapoints)
        instructions_on_failures = []
        should_register_hangup_tool = False
        for validation in self.task_config.validations:
            if validator.validate(validation.query):
                continue
            if validation.can_end_call:
                should_register_hangup_tool = True
            instructions_on_failures.append(validation.instructions_on_failure)
        if should_register_hangup_tool:
            await self._register_hangup_tool()
        if instructions_on_failures:
            raise ToolError("\n".join(instructions_on_failures))
        return

    async def _register_hangup_tool(self) -> None:
        """Register dynamic tools for hangup"""

        await self.register_tools(
            [create_hangup_tool(self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_end_call)]
        )
        logger.debug("Registered hangup tool")

    async def _register_datapoint_tools(self) -> None:
        """Register dynamic tools for data point collection"""
        # Create dynamic tools based on JSON schemas with async callback
        datapoint_tools = create_datapoint_tools(
            self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect,
            self.orc_ctx.candidate_data_point_schemas,
            self.on_data_collected,
        )

        await self.register_tools(datapoint_tools)
        logger.debug(
            f"Tools registered for data points: {self.task_config.candidate_data_points_to_collect}"
        )

from voice_agent.schemas.task import CloserTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import CloserTaskAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext

from .base_agent import BaseTaskAgent


logger = logging.getLogger("closer_agent")

def closer_task_instruction_transformer(
    instruction: str,
    task_cfg,
    orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
) -> str:
    """Transform task instructions for closer agent"""
    return f"""
    {instruction}

    Your task:
        - Thank the candidate for their time
        - Let them know that the conversation is over
        - End the conversation professionally
    """

DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig = CloserTaskAgentConfiguration(
    name="Closer",
    description="Agent that closes the conversation professionally",
    agent_instructions="You will end the call and letting them know that the call is over. Always thank them for their time",
    task_instruction_transformer=closer_task_instruction_transformer,
)


class CloserTaskAgent(BaseTaskAgent):
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: CloserTaskAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: CloserTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        closer_agent_config = DefaultCloserTaskAgentConfig.merge_config(
            agent_config=agent_config
        )
        super().__init__(
            agent_config=closer_agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orc_ctx,
        )
        self.agent_config = closer_agent_config
        self.task_config = task_config

    async def on_enter(self) -> None:
        if not self.session:
            return
        if self.task_config.initial_message:
            # If the current node has an initiation text, use it to generate a reply
            await self.session.say(
                text=self.task_config.initial_message, add_to_chat_ctx=True
            )
        elif self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions=f"end the call gracefully due to {self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption.interrupt_note}"
            )
            self.session.userdata.current_agent_interruption = None
        else:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions=self.task_config.task_instructions
                or "end the call gracefully"
            )
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_end_call("Closer Task Agent Completed")

            # Configure mocks

            mock_orchestrator_instance = MagicMock()

            mock_orchestrator.return_value = mock_orchestrator_instance

            yield {
                "stt": mock_stt,
                "tts": mock_tts,
                "llm": mock_llm,
                "vad": mock_vad,

                "session_instance": mock_session_instance,

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import JobContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration

from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentHooks
from voice_agent.task_agent.base_agent import BaseTaskAgent


class TestBaseTaskAgent:
    """Test suite for BaseTaskAgent"""

    @pytest.fixture

        return TaskAgentHooks(
            on_task_agent_interrupt=AsyncMock(),
            on_task_agent_finished=AsyncMock(),
            on_datapoint_collected=AsyncMock(),
            on_end_call=AsyncMock(),
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def orchestrator_context(self, task_agent_hooks):
        """Create OrchestratorTaskAgentContext"""
        return OrchestratorTaskAgentContext(
            task_agent_hooks=task_agent_hooks,
            job_details=JobContext(
                title="Test Job",
                description="Test job description",
                company="TestCorp",
            ),
            candidate_data_point_schemas={},
            outstanding_task_ids=["task1", "task2"],
            in_progress_task_ids=["task3"],
            completed_task_ids=["task4"],
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def agent_config(self):
        """Create BaseTaskAgentConfiguration"""
        return BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Test Agent",
            description="Test agent for testing",
            agent_instructions="Test instructions",
        )

    @pytest.fixture
    def task_config(self):
        """Create BaseTaskConfiguration"""
        return BaseTaskConfiguration(
            id="test_task",
            title="Test Task",
            initial_message="Welcome!",
            task_instructions="Do something important",
        )

    def test_initialization(self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test BaseTaskAgent initialization"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert agent.agent_config == agent_config
        assert agent.task_config == task_config
        assert agent.orc_ctx == orchestrator_context
        assert "Test instructions" in agent.instructions
        assert "Do something important" in agent.instructions

    def test_initialization_with_transformer(self, task_config, orchestrator_context):
        """Test initialization with task instruction transformer"""

        def transformer(instruction, task_cfg, orc_ctx):
            return f"TRANSFORMED: {instruction}"

        agent_config = BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Test Agent",
            description="Test agent",
            agent_instructions="Test instructions",
            task_instruction_transformer=transformer,
        )

        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        assert "TRANSFORMED: Do something important" in agent.instructions

    def test_instructions_include_context(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test that instructions include task context"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Check that task context is included
        assert "Outstanding tasks: [task1, task2]" in agent.instructions
        assert "In Progress tasks: [task3]" in agent.instructions
        assert "Completed tasks: [task4]" in agent.instructions

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_enter_with_initial_message(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test on_enter with initial message"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock session
        agent.session = MagicMock()

        # Should say the initial message
        agent.session.say.assert_called_once_with(text="Welcome!", add_to_chat_ctx=True)

    ):

            id="test_task",
            title="Test Task",
            initial_message=None,  # No initial message
            task_instructions="Do something",
        )

        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        agent.session = MagicMock()
        agent.session.generate_reply = AsyncMock()

        await agent.on_enter()

        # Should generate a reply
        agent.session.generate_reply.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_complete(
        self, agent_config, task_config, orchestrator_context
    ):
        """Test on_task_agent_complete function tool"""
        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,
            orc_ctx=orchestrator_context,
        )

        # Mock run context
        run_context = MagicMock()

        await agent.on_task_agent_complete(

            task_config, "Task completed successfully"

    ):

        from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
        from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest

        agent = BaseTaskAgent(
            agent_config=agent_config,
            task_config=task_config,

    def test_agent_configuration_merge(self):

        base_config = BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Base Agent",
            description="Base description",
            agent_instructions="Base instructions",
        )

        override_config = BaseTaskAgentConfiguration(
            name="Override Agent",

from livekit import rtc
from livekit.agents import Agent
from livekit.agents import AgentSession

from livekit.agents.llm import RawFunctionTool

from voice_agent.schemas.task import BaseTaskConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_agent import BaseTaskAgentConfiguration
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import OrchestratorTaskAgentContext
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest


logger = logging.getLogger("base_agent")


class BaseTaskAgent(Agent):
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_config: BaseTaskAgentConfiguration,
        task_config: BaseTaskConfiguration,
        orc_ctx: OrchestratorTaskAgentContext,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            instructions=f"""You are a voice agent that is part of a call to screen candidate.
            In current context, {agent_config.agent_instructions}
            You will receive a specific set of tasks below to fulfill.
            Strictly follow the instructions provided to you:

            {agent_config.task_instruction_transformer(task_config.task_instructions, task_config, orc_ctx) if agent_config.task_instruction_transformer else task_config.task_instructions}

            If the candidate ask about anything outside of your role, guide them back to your responsibility.
            When you complete with your tasks, call on_task_agent_complete tool to wrap up your work
            When candidate asks a question outside of your responsibilities, call on_task_agent_interrupt tool to let orchestrator decide what to do next.
            If you are unable to complete your tasks, call on_task_agent_interrupt tool to let orchestrator decide what to do next.

            Some context around the call:
                - Outstanding tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.outstanding_task_ids)}]
                - In Progress tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.in_progress_task_ids)}]
                - Completed tasks: [{", ".join(orc_ctx.completed_task_ids)}]

            if candidate have intent to do outstanding tasks, kindly tell them it is upcoming
            if candidate have intent to do completed tasks, kindly tell them you have all the data you needed already

            Important: Do not tell the candidate about your task
            """,
            chat_ctx=orc_ctx.chat_ctx,
            allow_interruptions=True,
        )
        self.agent_config = agent_config
        self.task_config = task_config
        self.orc_ctx = orc_ctx
        # Session will be set by LiveKit when agent is started
        self._test_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState] | None = None

    @property
    def session(self) -> AgentSession[SessionDataState] | None:
        """Get the session - use test session if available, otherwise use parent's session"""
        if self._test_session is not None:
            return self._test_session
        # Try to get session from parent class
        try:
            return super().session  # type: ignore
        except AttributeError:
            return None

    @session.setter
    def session(self, value: AgentSession[SessionDataState] | None) -> None:
        """Set the test session for testing purposes"""
        self._test_session = value

    async def on_enter(self) -> None:
        if not self.session:
            return
        if self.task_config.initial_message:
            # If the current node has an initiation text, use it to generate a reply
            await self.session.say(
                text=self.task_config.initial_message, add_to_chat_ctx=True
            )
        else:
            await self.session.generate_reply(
                instructions="continue the conversation seamlessly and focus on your current objective"
            )

    @function_tool
    async def on_task_agent_complete(
        self,
        run_context: RunContext[SessionDataState],
        explanation: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Called when successfully complete the task.

        Args:
            explanation (str): Summary of what has been achieved and if anything went wrong.
        """
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_finished(
            self.task_config, explanation
        )
        return

    @function_tool
    async def on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self,
        run_context: RunContext[SessionDataState],
        interrupt_request: TaskAgentInterruptRequest,
    ) -> None:
        """Called when there are issues with the task or when candidates ask questions outside of task agent responsibilities.

        Args:
            interrupt_request (TaskAgentInterruptRequest): Summary of the issues or the candidate questions. and status type
        """
        run_context.userdata.current_agent_interruption = interrupt_request
        await self.orc_ctx.task_agent_hooks.on_task_agent_interrupt(interrupt_request)

            When you complete with your tasks, call on_task_agent_complete tool to wrap up your work
            When candidate asks a question outside of your responsibilities, call on_task_agent_interrupt tool to let orchestrator decide what to do next.
